[[Erasklion's Spear]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] dropped by [[Erasklion the Prolific]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the first level of the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]].

== Stats ==
:[[Piercing damage]] 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Deep Wound]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

== Skin ==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Lesser Guardian Spear]]; however, it is colored a very bright white not achievable normally by applying [[dye]] to this item{{verify}}. <!-- does it perhaps only appear that much brighter due to the lighting in the screenshot? -->
